newsitem.title: USA: American Disposal buys two companies.
newsitem.headline: American Disposal buys two companies.

text.p: American Disposal Services Inc said Thursday it acquired two Rhode Island companies, T&J Trucking Company Inc and American Disposal Inc.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.

American Disposal also said its credit facility was increased by $23 million to $110 million, allowing the company to meet its growth targets. ING Capital and J.P. Morgan have already syndicated the financing, American Disposal said.
American Disposal is a regional, non-hazardous solid waste services company.
